name: gizza-ai/text-image-card
summary: Render a quote onto a styled shareable image card (PNG).

tool.description: Render a quote or short piece of text onto a styled, shareable image card and return a PNG. Set text (the quote — use \n for hard line breaks; it word-wraps to fit), an optional author byline, a theme (dark, light, sunset, ocean, forest, grape — a coloured background gradient + matching text colour), the card width/height in pixels (defaults 1080x1080, ideal for social posts), font_size (auto-shrinks if the text would not fit), align (left/center/right), and optional text_color / background_color hex overrides. Returns an image. Runs locally — the text never leaves the device.

text.description: The quote or short text to render onto the card (use \n for hard line breaks; it word-wraps automatically).

author.description: Optional attribution shown as a smaller byline under the text (e.g. a person's name).

theme.description: Colour theme (background gradient + text colour): dark, light, sunset, ocean, forest, or grape.

font_size.description: Starting body font size in pixels (default 64). Auto-shrinks if the text would not fit.

align.description: Horizontal text alignment: left, center, or right (default center).

text_color.description: Override the theme text colour as #rgb or #rrggbb hex (optional).

background_color.description: Override the theme background with a solid colour as #rgb or #rrggbb hex; disables the gradient (optional).
